Complete Guide to JPG to PDF

Submitting job expense receipts, compiling scanned identification cards (like passport or driver's license photos), and packaging photographic portfolios requires converting multiple image files into a single, professional PDF document. TECHTIS JPG to PDF delivers an instant, zero-latency conversion tool that operates entirely within your browser.

Our intuitive workspace lets you upload multiple photos at once, reorder pages by dragging thumbnail tiles, and customize page geometry. You can set output page sizes to standard A4, US Letter, or auto-fit directly to each image's native dimensions while configuring margins for clean printing.

Because processing runs locally using client-side JavaScript, your personal photos, confidential business receipts, and official ID cards are never uploaded to any third-party server, ensuring complete data security.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about JPG to PDF and privacy

How to convert JPG images to PDF online for free?
Upload your JPG, PNG, or WebP pictures to TECHTIS JPG to PDF. Drag to reorder photos, choose page size (A4, US Letter, or Fit to Image), and set margins. Click 'Convert to PDF' to download your consolidated document.
How do I combine front and back ID card photos into one PDF?
Select both front and back photos. Verify the order on the thumbnail grid, choose A4 size, and click Convert. You get a single official PDF ready for bank or government uploads.
Are my personal photos uploaded to any third-party cloud server?
No! All image stitching and PDF generation execute strictly in your browser RAM using WebAssembly. Your photos remain 100% private on your device.
Can I adjust the page orientation and margins?
Yes. You can toggle between Portrait and Landscape orientations and choose No Margin, Small Margin, or Standard Margin.
How many images can I combine into a single PDF?
There is no artificial limit. You can combine dozens of photos into a 100+ page document without subscription fees.
Can I convert photos directly from my smartphone camera?
Yes! Tap the upload zone to choose photos directly from your phone's camera roll or take new photos on the spot.
Does TECHTIS add any watermarks to the created PDF?
Never. All documents created on TECHTIS are 100% watermark-free and completely free.
Will my photos lose quality during conversion?
No. Images are embedded into the PDF container maintaining their native pixel resolution and sharpness.
